name: SmarTone Telecommunications Holdings Limited
summary: SmarTone Telecommunications Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides local and international telecommunication services in Hong Kong and internationally. The company offers voice, multimedia, mobile, and fixed fiber broadband services for the consumer and corporate markets; and re-sells mobile devices and accessories. It also engages in the sale of handsets and accessories; and provision of customer support, telemarketing, and wireless fixed services. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong. SmarTone Telecommunications Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Sun Hung Kai Properties Limited.
